lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The auction moon. Half the sector's scum bidding on salvage that isn't theirs.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Your sword is down there, Cipher. And somebody paid a lot to make sure it never reaches the block.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Get in, find Mira, get out. I'll keep the Cairn warm.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That blade of yours has been talking in its sleep. The steel remembers what your head can't.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: There's a place on this rock that can read old metal. Take the sword down. Listen to what it says.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Overseer's hunters found our wake. They're sweeping the port below.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Somebody sabotaged your killswitch — the answer is down there with the hunt. Don't let them box you in.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Kael Vor. A name the Program hung its bodies on. The ledger says he's here.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Ashes pay their debts, Cipher. Go collect.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Iron Dojo. Three masters, one citadel, and a bell that hasn't rung since the purge.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Morrigan's waiting at the window. Climb, fight, and don't let the beauty fool you — it's a cage.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: A reliquary of dead lanes and kept blades. The names they erased are shelved down there.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Coral Vex knows the stacks. Find her, and bring the names home.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: A garden where nobody speaks above the wind. Khall's grief grows here.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Walk it quiet, Cipher. Some answers only come to those who stop swinging.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The pit goes down further than the charts admit. Sable says the water draws itself.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: There's a voice in the deep that reaches every world at once. Go hear it before it hears you.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Rust keeps better records than men. The ledger below has a page with your number on it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cassie and Vess are already counting. Don't keep them waiting.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Ghosts first, origins after. That's the order the dead prefer.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Unbroken ward is real — I've watched a man take a killing blow and stand. Watch for it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cold deck. Frost makes every rail a promise it won't keep — Gryph's words, not mine.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The record's whole down there. It says who drew the leash. Go read the name.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Dr. Heris built you, built the switch, and built the flaw that saved you. All in one pair of hands.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: She's in the sterile levels. This one's not a fight, Cipher. It's a reckoning.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: End of the ladder. Khall's throne, and every ash we've raised on the way up.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Whatever you are when you walk back up that ramp — that's what you chose to be. Go finish it.
